caption: The drawing depicts a brown ceramic jug with a single handle on the upper right side and a cork stopper fitted into a short neck at the top. The jug has a slightly elongated and rounded body that narrows toward the base. Near the top, just below the neck, there is a blue painted numeral "2" followed by the text "CLARK & FOX" and "ATHENS" in uppercase letters, also in blue. On the upper part of the jug’s body, below the inscription, there is a stylized, blue-painted bird motif facing left, featuring simple lines and dots for details. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige or off-white color with no other objects or decorations present. The artist’s signature, "N. Amontea," is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
